article.title: Amendments of Act 52 of 1962.
article.content:
248Amendments of Act 52 of 1962.

Section 248  ·  Part V  ·  page 154 of the Act
The Customs Act, 1962 shall be amended in the manner specified in the Fourth Schedule.
